subject: Closed-loop MAP: sample provisioning, constraints & acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Tanya Rivera <tanya@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Closed-loop MAP: sample provisioning, constraints & acceptance criteria

Tanya —

Following our call today, attaching a working Mutual Action Plan draft and the initial package of test cases you requested. High level from Redwood's side: we can provision a time-limited sandbox (shared VPC) and a scoped dataset bundle for evaluation, with the following constraints we need to confirm before we hand over files: 

- Usage is strictly for evaluation of model served via Redwood's hosted runtime tied to this PO/deal (NB-2026-137). No rehosting or redistribution.
- Data retention: files will be available in the sandbox for up to 90 days post-provisioning; beyond that they will be removed unless we agree in writing to extend.
- Results/outputs: Northbridge may export aggregate metrics and non-PHI/PII model outputs; raw tokens and model caches are prohibited from being persisted outside the sandbox.
- IP: data owners retain dataset IP; Redwood gets no ownership of dataset content. Evaluation results do not alter those terms.

I've attached: Northbridge_MPA_v1.docx (draft MAP), nb_testcases_bundle_v1.zip (sample prompt packs & testcases), and a calendar invite stub for the provisioning window.

Ask: Can you confirm the procurement contact who will sign the MAP and whether your security team needs the SOC2 excerpt we circulated last week? We also need a single point of contact for data handling confirmation (name + email).

Next steps (proposed):
1) You confirm procurement contact + acceptance of constraints (by EOD Thu 12/3).
2) We provision sandbox and share S3/creds (read-only) and testcases within 48 hours of signature.
3) Joint acceptance run (5 business days), then close-out and documented destruction at day 90.

Happy to tweak the MAP language if procurement/legal require redlines — looping in Laura for contracting/Docs flow.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Northbridge_MPA_v1.docx (docx), nb_testcases_bundle_v1.zip (zip), redwood-sample-sandbox-invite.ics (ics)

From: Tanya Rivera <tanya@northbridge.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Northbridge Analytics Procurement <procurement@northbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Closed-loop MAP: sample provisioning, constraints & acceptance criteria

Jordan —

Thanks for the summary and attachments. Quick clarifications from our side before we move to signature: 

1) We need a clause that prohibits any downstream use of the testcases to train internal models at Redwood or by any Redwood partners — a strict "evaluation only" carveout.
2) Can you confirm whether outputs that contain customer-provided PII will be scrubbed or redacted prior to allowing exports? Our compliance team will not sign without that guarantee.
3) Procurement will need a 30-day payment term option in the MAP; Evan from ContractingPros is on copy and will handle the commercial clause language.

Procurement contact for signature: Tanya Rivera <procurement@northbridge.ai>. We will get a security checklist back by Thursday 12/3. If that looks good, we'll have procurement sign and return.

One other ask: can Redwood provide a short (one-page) runbook describing how destruction is performed and an attestation template we can use post-destruction?

Thanks,
Tanya Rivera
Head of Data Partnerships
Northbridge Analytics

---
Attachment requested: SOC2-excerpt if available (we saw mention on your platform doc).

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tanya Rivera <tanya@northbridge.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Chu <evan@contractingpros.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Closed-loop MAP: sample provisioning, constraints & acceptance criteria

Tanya —

Looping in contracting language and confirming a few items on our side: 

- Redwood will add an explicit "no training/reuse" clause to the MAP: "Provided materials and evaluation datasets are licensed to Northbridge Analytics for evaluation only; Redwood and Redwood partners will not use these datasets to train, fine-tune, or benchmark models outside the agreed sandbox for the duration of the license."
- On exports of outputs: we will implement an export filter for PII-containing outputs. For any suspected PII exports we will require a redaction step prior to enabling the download. We will provide the attestation template and a destruction runbook (one page) with the DocuSign packet.
- Payment terms: we can show a 30-day invoice term in the MAP but the discount/credit structure will remain as previously discussed (credits applied on first invoice).

I will prepare a redline and the attestation template; Jordan, please proceed to provision the sandbox only after procurement returns signed MAP.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Legal Counsel, Revenue
Redwood Inference

Attachment note: I'll attach the redline and attestation as part of the DocuSign envelope (Evan, expect a request).

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tanya Rivera <tanya@northbridge.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 14:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Closed-loop MAP: sample provisioning, constraints & acceptance criteria

Tanya —

Operational note on the sandbox provisioning and dataset handling: 

- We'll provision a scoped S3 read-only bucket with short-lived temporary credentials and an interface that routes all inference requests back through the Redwood hosted runtime tied to the NB-2026-137 account. There won't be an option to download model weights or persistent KV caches.
- For the PII scrub/redaction: we'll apply a candidate filter and flag exports that match the pattern list your team provides. For any flagged exports we will hold the file and request manual approval for release after redaction. This is consistent with how we handle other regulated evals.
- Destruction flow: at T+90 days we run an automated wipe of the S3 prefix and revoke sandbox credentials; we will run verification checksum logs and provide an attestation signed by Redwood's security operations.

Timing impact: if procurement signs by EOD Thu (12/3), we can schedule provisioning for Mon 12/7 and open a 5-business-day evaluation window starting 12/8. If signatures slip, timelines will move accordingly.

-Marcus
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: operational hookup checklist — internal only)

From: Tanya Rivera <tanya@northbridge.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 15:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Closed-loop MAP: sample provisioning, constraints & acceptance criteria

Team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarifications. Procurement has reviewed and Evan from ContractingPros has accepted the redline with the "no-training" language inserted. Our security team also confirmed the PII export filter and requested the SOC2-excerpt — I've attached their requested checklist response in a reply to your security mailbox (cc'ed).

We are ready to proceed: procurement signs the MAP today and I'll upload the signed DocuSign PDF to the HubSpot deal record (NB-2026-137) once complete. Please proceed with provisioning on Monday 12/7 as Marcus outlined.

One small ask for the provisioning run: can you enable a single read-only S3 path for audit logs export so our compliance team can pull anonymized metrics (no token-level data)? If that's technically feasible, confirm and we'll close.

Thanks again,
Tanya Rivera
Head of Data Partnerships
Northbridge Analytics
